protocol: Exploratory repair after observing the previous gate and reused 45-case panel. Freeze before inspecting the separate search stress results. Replay frozen HCL + SkillOpt candidate stopping states. Add exactly one real regional call only when tolerance for the four-action limit permits, no region has been attempted, and the unchanged stage-matched fit memory recommends a region. Then answer. Otherwise reuse identical outputs. Compare to both the original candidate and repaired baseline. Assess first on the previously seen 16-case validation gate; run separate partial-tool search stress only if higher F1 than baseline and nondecreasing correct count. Do not reopen 45-case panel for this rule. No pristine search-free MedCTA holdout remains.
